findings.summary: Partial transient-policy writes can retain private input.
findings.evidence: privatePolicy writes before publishRelease enters its cleanup finally; an interrupted/failed write can leave its owned file.
findings.action: Added construction finally cleanup, focused ENOSPC classification and unchanged unexpected-error propagation; partial-write and error-identity tests pass.

findings.summary: A bridge exiting before its first line leaves the fixture waiting for its outer timeout.
findings.evidence: The response awaits only readline line; child close cannot settle that promise.
findings.action: Raced first response with close/error, retained bounded diagnostics and added static exit-23 source/compiled assertions.

findings.summary: Replacement-pattern commit subjects corrupt generated notes.
findings.evidence: Parent actual generateNotes probe retained {{COMMITS}} and lost the literal subject; string replacement interprets dollar patterns.
findings.action: Inserted generated subjects with a callback and asserted literal dollar replacement sequences.

findings.summary: A replacement annotated tag with the same commit escapes the scanned object identity.
findings.evidence: Parent actual verifyRemoteTag probe admitted a different raw tag object when its peeled commit matched; local scan covers only the original annotation.
findings.action: Captured the raw local tag object and compared remote raw identity plus peeled commit; same-commit replacement annotation is refused.

findings.summary: Accepted publication report and policy digest are not retained for maintainer evidence.
findings.evidence: The report remains only in the ephemeral checkout and gh output is suppressed. Release notes themselves do persist in the created release; retain the sanitized report and notes digest in workflow output.
findings.action: Emitted the accepted sanitized exact report and notes SHA256 to workflow output before the write; tests exclude policy values and token input.

findings.summary: Generic CLI failure hides causes and next actions.
findings.evidence: The catch emits one message for all failures; after a create timeout, its no-release claim can also be false because the remote outcome is unknown.
findings.action: Added fixed allowlisted cause/action categories and an explicitly unconfirmed write outcome; actual CLI and timeout tests withhold raw diagnostics.

findings.summary: Preview instructions require notes before the local tag that the command requires.
findings.evidence: The runbook prerequisite precedes tag creation, while validateCandidate requires the matching local tag and four event variables.
findings.action: Documented an independent disposable clone with its local preview tag and explicit event environment, followed by original-repository tag review and separately authorized push.

findings.summary: Duplicated SemVer admission could silently diverge.
findings.evidence: Both current readers enforce the same strict grammar and 64-character bound; no currently divergent input was identified. The release validator must run before workspace dependencies are installed. Hypothetical future divergence is not an observed defect.

findings.summary: Bridge first-line wait does not settle on child exit.
findings.evidence: Same verified first-line promise defect as E2; preserve a separate reviewer row.
findings.action: Raced first response with close/error, retained bounded diagnostics and added static exit-23 source/compiled assertions.

findings.summary: Release range lacks competing, annotated, merged and tie boundary tests.
findings.evidence: The one-prior-tag fixture cannot detect ordering regressions; all these branch/range cases are absent.
findings.action: Added competing, annotated, unreachable, merged and equal-distance tag fixtures asserting exact included commits.

findings.summary: The actual release audit CLI dispatch is untested.
findings.evidence: Preverified: existing tests invoke requireAudit/auditOutcome, never releaseMain or the CLI; removing dispatch leaves assertions green.
findings.action: Executed actual audit CLI against the existing deterministic scanner fixture for accepted and blocked outcomes.

findings.summary: Nearest-boundary selection among multiple previous release tags is untested.
findings.evidence: Preverified: reversing the distance comparator passes the only eligible previous-tag test; resulting notes can repeat earlier releases.
findings.action: Added competing, annotated, unreachable, merged and equal-distance tag fixtures asserting exact included commits.

findings.summary: A source diff cannot establish workflow execution.
findings.evidence: The activation command, rendered workflow, delegated implementation and reviews were actually executed; source-only review is not the run evidence. Retained command results establish execution.

findings.summary: Local fixtures do not establish a hosted release or real three-platform execution.
findings.evidence: No hosted run or real release is authorized/executed. A separately authorized exact-tag hosted run with all three job URLs and authenticated remote checks would settle operational behavior; local success does not claim it.

findings.summary: Runtime identity tests exercise the relevant version surfaces directly.
findings.evidence: This is positive alignment, not a defect: actual source/compiled health, archive, HTTP MCP and stdio assertions passed.

findings.summary: The diff adds no migration behavior or new upgrade tests.
findings.evidence: Migration changes were not needed: existing 27 focused regressions passed and were included in the parent full DB coverage run; documentation preserves the inspected boundary.

findings.summary: Test definitions alone do not prove execution or verification status.
findings.evidence: Parent command-start file/index evidence and successful aggregate/verifier exits are independent of all sprint rows; no bookkeeping value was used as proof.

status: all corrections applied; final parent aggregate and standalone verifier passed
followupRisk: The raw annotated-tag binding and its final evidence/output/GitHub write sequence have focused proofs but have not received a second independent review or an authorized hosted execution.
